title: Peter/Quotes
summary:
"I work for the Foundation. Sure I know about Titans but to actually see one?"
- Peter to Sophie Casterwill, (Into the River of Secrets)

"Miss Attitude spooks me!"
- Peter to Sophie Casterwill, about Zhalia Moon, (Into the River of Secrets)

"When the Foundation approached me, I realised their ideals were exactly what I was looking for. To protect history and not exploit it, to learn without limits, to explore ancient secrets and preserve forgotten traditions."
- Peter to Lok Lambert about how he joined the Huntik Foundation, (Into the River of Secrets)

"Nostradamus had all kinds of Casterwill illusion powers."
- Peter to Billie, (The Tower of Nostradamus)
